app.title: I built a low-latency AI companion that plays Skyrim with me
app.author: pantelisk
app.description: A real‑time AI companion that interacts with the player in Skyrim, using low‑latency LLM inference to respond to in‑game events.
proposed_tests: Run the companion in headless mode and ensure it starts without errors
Send a mock in‑game event via the companion's API and verify a response is returned
Measure latency from event trigger to assistant reply to confirm <100ms
